## Why (measured on `origin/main` `5656c5638a`, 2026-10-14)

- `rest-channel.md:51` 「✓ 启动 run 走 op `workflow_dispatch`:解锁物是白名单 run 才启;入表只经 workflow 自己的 PR」 is the table's only sentence on starting a run; it names no workflow and no inputs. After PR #23209, `WORKFLOW_DISPATCH_INPUTS` in `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs` carries `release.yml` with exactly `{ refresh_version_pr: true }` (ref `main`, the stroke alone in its actions file; `force`, `false`, an absent input and any other input refused by name).
- The reference is what a seat reads before writing; a stroke the reference does not list is one a seat re-derives from the script or skips. #23193 recorded the cost: two Version-PR refreshes run from the linked account instead of the relay.

## What done looks like

- One line in 〈写侧〉 after `:51`: the release refresh is a relay stroke — `[{ "op": "workflow_dispatch", "workflow": "release.yml", "ref": "main", "inputs": { "refresh_version_pr": true } }]`, alone, after a release-path fix merges; every other input or ref is refused. ≤ 120 bytes or two lines paid by two deletions; the spelling is read from the landed `ops.mjs`, not from this card.
- `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:pm-governed-prose` green; `skip-changeset`; Tier S by the register (`check-governed-merges --pr` decides at landing).
